name: Cavalry by Canva
description: Drive Cavalry from your LLM client. Automate repetitive motion-graphics tasks and build reusable Cavalry tools with custom UI.
long_description:
The Cavalry MCP server lets an LLM client read and manipulate scenes in the Cavalry desktop application. Use it to automate repetitive tasks, generate animation setups, or build entirely new tools and workflows that you can save for later.

Key capabilities:
- Run JavaScript directly against the open Cavalry scene
- Save reusable scripts (with optional UI: sliders, buttons, modals) into Cavalry's script library
- Syntax-check scripts before running them, so the LLM gets fast feedback

Setup:

The Cavalry MCP server runs locally on your device. It's only active when both your MCP client and Cavalry are running. You'll need to stay up to date with the latest version of the Cavalry desktop app.

To use the Cavalry MCP server:
- Open Cavalry by Canva
- The MCP server is on by default; Preferences has the MCP Server configuration options
- Install this extension in your MCP client (e.g. Claude Desktop)

The first time a client connects, Cavalry shows an approval dialog naming the app; the connection is refused until you allow it. The MCP server is local-only and does not transmit your scenes to any server.

tools.name: read_preamble
tools.description: Returns the Cavalry MCP preamble. execute_script refuses to run until this has been called in the session.

tools.name: execute_script
tools.description: Execute JavaScript against the open Cavalry scene and return console output and the last-evaluated value.

tools.name: preflight_script
tools.description: Compile a JavaScript snippet without running it, to check for syntax errors.

tools.name: preflight_shader
tools.description: Compile-check an SkSL shader/filter source without installing or running it.

tools.name: cleanup_workspace
tools.description: Delete scratch files a session created in its Cavalry temp session folder.

tools.name: list_library_scripts
tools.description: List the names of the scripts in the Cavalry script library.

tools.name: read_library_script
tools.description: Read a script from the Cavalry script library.

tools.name: save_script_to_library
tools.description: Save a completed script to the Cavalry script library for use later.

tools.name: get_api_function
tools.description: Full definition of a JavaScript API function.

tools.name: get_layer_definition
tools.description: Full attribute list for a layer type.

tools.name: snapshot_layer
tools.description: Render a single layer (or the whole active composition when layerId is omitted) to a PNG for visual recognition.
